title: Privacy Officer: Patient Identity Conflicts and Public Exposure

fields.to: Administrator on Call (Incident Commander), ED Medical Director, Public Information Officer
fields.subject: FW: Critical Privacy Events — Dual Record, Board Exposure, Disclosure to Neighbor Hospital
fields.note: Three things for the log. We shared patient summaries with a neighboring hospital for treatment, which is permitted. Two registration clerks used both numbers for the same patient, so there are two records for one person and a risk that results post to the wrong one. A reporter was able to see a paper tracking board through the ED door for an hour. I want the board covered and the reconciliation list started.
fields.signature:
Joyce Tanaka
Chief Privacy Officer
Ottawa River Regional Medical Center
